definitions.name: Urban / Regional Context
definitions.formula: Separate XL context score from municipality/FUA context, population/density where available, and known context-class resolver. It is not part of the Local Quality Score.
thresholds: 85-100 = Metropolitan core context.
70-84 = Large city context.
50-69 = Regional city context.
30-49 = Small city/town context.
Below 30 or missing = Limited regional evidence.

definitions.name: Mobility Access
definitions.formula: Weighted multimodal reachability score derived from explicit mode KPIs: Walking KPI 35%, Cycling KPI 25%, Transit KPI 25%, and Car-driving KPI 15%. Each mode uses routed isochrone POI reachability where available plus mode-relevant nearest-feature, infrastructure, and stop evidence.
thresholds: Walking KPI uses the 10-minute routed walking isochrone where available, nearest POI distance, stop access, and pedestrian/support infrastructure.
Cycling KPI uses the 10-minute routed cycling isochrone where available, nearest POI distance, stop access, and bike/support infrastructure.
Transit KPI uses GTFS/OSM stop availability, nearest stop distance, and pedestrian/support access evidence; routed transit catchments are not inferred.
Car-driving KPI uses the 15-minute routed driving isochrone where available, nearest POI distance, and car-support evidence.
Geometric radii are not used as reachability KPI evidence.

definitions.name: Green/Blue Access
definitions.formula: Green/open/blue share in the L-scale context normalized against a 35% target. Private green is excluded where known; semi-public green classes should receive partial credit in later exact clipping.
thresholds: 0% green/open/blue = 0.
17.5% green/open/blue = 50.
35% or more green/open/blue = 100.

definitions.name: Urban Mix
definitions.formula: Combines area-based land-use family entropy at 60% and POI category diversity at 40% where both are available.
thresholds: 0.00 mix index = 0.
0.50 mix index = 50.
1.00 mix index = 100.

definitions.name: Social Infrastructure Access
definitions.formula: Distance-first score for education/childcare, health, grocery/commerce, and civic/admin POIs, with count as secondary support.
thresholds: Nearest essential POI within 500 m = 100 distance subscore.
Nearest essential POI within 800 m = 70 distance subscore.
Nearest essential POI within 1,000 m = 40 distance subscore.
Category count contributes a secondary min(100, count * 25) subscore.

definitions.name: Tree Canopy
definitions.formula: Proxy score from mapped tree points, tree-row evidence, and green/open-space support. It is a canopy/shade screening KPI, not measured canopy cover.
thresholds: 65 mapped tree points/km² contributes 100 to the tree-density subscore.
Each mapped tree-row feature contributes 35 points up to 100 for the row subscore.
Green/open-space percentage supports the score using the same 35% target as Green/Blue Access.

definitions.name: Station Axis
definitions.formula: Transit-axis screening score from nearest stop/station distance, mode hierarchy, stop density, and public-transport route/corridor evidence.
thresholds: Nearest stop/station within 300 m = 100 distance subscore.
Nearest stop/station within 500 m = 80 distance subscore.
Tram, subway, light-rail, and rail modes contribute stronger mode evidence than bus-only access.
Line/corridor evidence comes from loaded Overpass route and corridor geometries where available.

definitions.name: Climate/Heat Resilience
definitions.formula: Experimental proxy planned from green percentage, tree density, blue presence, sealed/parking share, and shade context.
thresholds: Not included in the MVP composite until proxy indicators are emitted.

definitions.name: Streetscape Quality
definitions.formula: Experimental M-scale score planned from tree edge, enclosure, frontage, and walking/cycling infrastructure.
thresholds: Height-to-width target range: 0.7-2.0.
Sun/shadow remains visual/caveat context, not a scored component.

definitions.name: Development Potential
definitions.formula: Post-MVP separate opportunity score. It should not be part of the default urban quality score.
thresholds: Protected green/open space must not count as underused development land.
Planning-law assessment is out of MVP scope.

strategies.name: Balanced Urban Quality
strategies.description: Default urban quality diagnosis across mobility, green/blue access, mix, and everyday services.

strategies.name: Mobility-Oriented
strategies.description: Emphasizes low-car movement, public transport, and active mobility.

strategies.name: Green/Climate
strategies.description: Emphasizes green/blue access and climate proxy readiness using current MVP inputs.

strategies.name: Infill Context
strategies.description: Interim context preset for transformation discussions until a separate development-potential score is implemented.
